prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final in-game cooperative defense lobby environment background, widescreen 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Primary request: a premium Korean collectible RPG GAME LOBBY, an atmospheric fortress deployment terrace where the player's actual cutout characters will stand. Scene: a monumental fortified courtyard converted to a high-end field command staging area at blue hour. Huge distant open gate shows three long elevated stone causeways disappearing toward a misty ruined city. A luminous turquoise guardian crystal in an elaborate mechanical stone shrine is off to the far right background, subtle ivory banners, graphite metal railings, few dim warm lamps. The foreground lower half is a broad unobstructed weathered stone and dark metal platform with subtle cyan inlaid guide lines and believable reflected ambient light. Crucial composition: low eye-level camera, NOT top-down/isometric. Horizontally broad empty character stage across the middle 70% of the image; foreground characters will later be composited with their feet at 82% image height. Leave visually quiet upper left for title and top HUD, and dark clear bottom 12% for game buttons. Background must be clearly visible and immersive with cinematic depth, not an abstract gradient or blank dark room. Style: exquisite painterly 2D/3D hybrid RPG environment art, finely detailed yet clean shapes, polished game key-art finish, no heavy bloom, no gaudy ornament. Palette graphite stone, slate blue, controlled luminous cyan, ivory highlights. Strong but soft lateral rim light suitable for separately composited anime fantasy characters. Constraints: no people, no characters, no creatures, NO TEXT, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI panels, no cards, no buttons drawn into the image. Keep the entire usable foreground empty. Landscape wide composition.
